items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: I studied with a guy who played with the New Orleans Symphony Orchestra, Gilbert Mitchell. I studied with him in 55. And I studied with him a good while... I took lessons from Gilbert Mitchell as soon as I got out of the Navy.

ctx.x: Did you ever play on a symphony?

Well a symphonic band when I was in the Navy. Like a concert band? Yeah. But we didn't have the strings. We didn't have the strings. Well I studied with a guy who played with the New Orleans Symphony Orchestra, Gilbert Mitchell. I studied with him in 55. And I studied with him a good while. That was when you were at Xavier.
